text: Implemented Arrow-compatible immutable storage in scalafim-frame: separate DataType/PhysicalEncoding/ArrayLayout, owned+borrowed Buffer leases with retained slicing and accounting, bit-packed validity/booleans, little-endian Int32/Int64/Float32/Float64/timestamp, UTF-8 offsets, dictionary encoding, RecordBatch, Table[Schema], scoped BatchSource, early termination and failed-collection cleanup. Shared-source forbidden-type audit is clean. Evidence: frameJVM/test and frameJS/test pass 21/21 each; bounded JVM receipt in docs/benchmarks/frame-storage.md reports checksum and owners 2->0 after close.
